trigger.reportedFullPackageFailure: Existing 5000ms unit deadline exceeded under a full package run; timeout preserved.

changes: Finite zero multiplicand uses product plus addend, preserving signed-zero addition.
Finite nonzero multiplicands with zero addend use one correctly rounded multiplication, preserving negative zero after underflow.
Finite nonzero FMA decomposition reuses one private 8-byte DataView instead of allocating on each call.
repair.ownership: Scratch remains unexported and private to each module evaluation/realm. The finite number-only branch has no await, yield or host callback; each DataView read copies bits to immutable bigint before the next component writes. Calls with non-number/nonfinite values return through existing early branches before using scratch. No producer bytes or invocation-owned mutable buffers are retained.
repair.budgets: No host.tick calls, quadrature cache policies, cache capacities, cancellation checks or numeric iteration bounds changed.

inMemoryCandidateDifferential.comparison: Object.is against original arithmetic for a Cartesian set covering signed zeros, subnormal values, overflow, NaN, infinities and cancellation-sensitive factors; all equal.
inMemoryCandidateDifferential.classification: Preimplementation temporary in-memory measurement; not a copied implementation in maintained tests.

afterRealModuleInverse.assertions: Exact 557149 tick count and existing native-golden relative bound both verified.

focusedRuntime.warmedCacheWorkAndCancellationAssertions: Existing statistics work/cancellation guard cases passed unchanged.

limits: Before/after timing samples were taken with varying concurrent workspace activity; they are evidence of reduced work/allocation, not a controlled benchmark or a guaranteed deadline on every host.
Existing assertions and timeout limits were neither weakened nor increased. No wall-clock unit assertion was added.
A FIFO quadrature-cache experiment showed no reduction in FMA calls or ticks and was rejected without product changes.
Root retains full maintained package lint/test/build and final delivery ownership. This scoped cohort does not certify complete Gnumeric codec parity.
